item.title: Show HN: MetaArena – Compare & Rank 5,353 Meta Global AI Hackathon Projects
item.description: Hey HN! Recently Meta wrapped up their Global Developer Hackathon ( https://dev.meta.ai/events/global-hackathon ) which had a $1M prize pool (!!): 34K developers applied, 20K accepted, and over 5K projects were submitted. With this crazy volume, it was infeasible to rank or even shortlist the best projects with human review. On the other hand, AI scoring against a rubric led to disappointing results. In an effort to surface and spotlight the best projects, I built MetaArena ( https://meta-hackathon.com/ ). It compares just two projects head-to-head, let's you pick which you thought was the str Score 78. Prize: $1,000,000

Yesterday we launched Apps and Functions, our first move into PaaS. In the spirit of having fun, we’re running a hackathon.
